command: echo '[monthly_clean] prune workspace/exports/ older than 30d and workspace/your_files/.DS_Store + bundle tmp' && find ~/workspace/exports -type f -mtime +30 -delete 2>/dev/null; find ~/workspace/your_files -name '.DS_Store' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned $(date)
description: Monthly clean — prune exports/ older than 30d, clean .DS_Store, enforce workspace/bundles/zero_deps flag, keep fs optimized
